pages.resume: ## Overview In RELL Seas, Accessories is a core mechanic, which allows users to give themselves different status, bonus effects and cosmetic options for their character. At the moment, 6 types of Accessories are rumored to be in the game, which includes: Shirts, Pants, Capes, Necklaces, Masks and Hats. These can be equipped on the right side of the screen in the game menu.
## Overview The Allosaurs fruit (Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Allosaurus) is an -type God Fruit that allows the user to transform into an allosaurus hybrid and a full allosaurus at will. __TOC__

champs.description: Slash three times and stomp to the ground.

pages.resume: ## Armament Haki Haki is a form of Haki that allows the user to use their own spiritual energy, essentially creating an invisible armor around themselves, granting incredible offensive and defensive capabilities. Specifically, this form of Haki can be used to injure God Fruit users who are immune to normal physical attacks, such as Logia users.

## Overview The Avalonian race is one of the few Races available in RELL Seas. The primary physical feature of this race is the pair of white angelic wings on the back. It's unknown as to how the wings will be used in the game.
Barrier (Bari Bari no Mi) is a -type God Fruit that allows the user to generate barriers, making them a Barrier Human.

## Overview In RELL Seas, players have the option to customize their ship's sails to have an emblem on it, which will show you or other players what crew you belong to. If you are also apart of one of the NPC crews, you'll also be able to display the emblem on your ship's sail. Please note: As these sails display your crew's emblem, be warned - this may also make enemy crews notice you easier.

## Overview Beastman is one of the few races in RELL Seas. Beastman has a white, brown, pink and yellow skintone. This race also has goat horns for you to customize. The Beastman race can only mode up when looking at the moon during night time that changes every 2 in real life hours.
The Ushi Ushi no Mi, Model: Bison is a -type God Fruit that allows its user to transform into a full bison or a half-bison hybrid at will.
Bomb (Bomu Bomu no Mi) is a -type God Fruit that allows the user to make any part of their body explode, whether it be their limbs, hair, mucus, even breath or cough.

## Overview Bosses are powerful enemies with unique move sets and significantly larger health pools than standard enemies. When in range, a boss health bar appears at the top of the screen. Bosses often drop exclusive items and are categorised by difficulty into Mini Bosses and Greater Bosses. with each tier posing an increasingly greater challenge. By fishing, you can get fish and unconfirmed items.

## Overview Ships can be extremly customized. The player can pick and choose where to place furnitures, essentials , and decorations on the ship. The ship color and material can be changed. Additionally the sails can have the players crew logo on them. Players can modify multiple parts of ships. Some ships have more modification slots than others. To customise a ship, use the Ship in a Bottle item

## Overview The shovel is used for treasure hunting. Going to a treasure spot area and digging on the marked spot will let you dig up chests. In these chests, you can find rare armours, weapons , and god fruits.

## Overview Sir Pitcher is an Agile Poster that allows the player to Geppo Dash rush after a grab throw. The player throws his enemy in the air, Geppo Dash 3 times, and slams to the ground. The player can choose what direction he wants to throw the opponent at.

Each layer has its unique Leviathan boss with its own unique drops. The deeper the layer, the faster oxygens depletes. The player needs to craft diving gear to negate it. ## Overview Thieving is one of the many nonlinear ways to progress in RELL Seas. The max points for thieving are 500. The most likely method of getting points is by: * Stealing * Pick-pocketing * Pick locking chests There might be different levels of lock-picks that you unlock by putting points into the thieving talent.

pages.resume: ## Overview You can upgrade your weapon about 20 times to make it better for combat usage. Stronger weapons have fewer upgrades, and weaker weapons have more. This means that every weapon could be viable for combat, even the early game ones. The materials for the upgrades are randomly generated, so you'll have to explore the game to upgrade your weapon to its full potential.

The Venom Fruit (Doku Doku no Mi) is a -type God Fruit that grants the user the ability to produce and control different types of poison, as well as grants immunity to all forms of poison, making the user a Poison Human This ability is not to be confused with a Logia-type power, as the user cannot transform their body into poison.

In RELL Seas, weapons play a central role in combat and progression. Each weapon features a unique model and set of abilities. Weapons are categorised into 4 different classes: Light, Medium, Heavy, and Ranged. Each class affects gameplay characteristics such as attack speed, range, and damage output.
